hooks.text: 墨西哥与日本碰撞诞生的新东京黑帮政权
hooks.excerpt: Our story takes place in Nuevo-Tokyo, an offspring of chaos that was born when Japan and Mexico collided in fire, power and betrayal. A land where a new feudal regime was forged between Narcos and Yakuzas, forming a new ruling class, The Narkuzas.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 精准移动站位与时机攻击决定连招战
hooks.excerpt: Precise movement, positioning and perfectly timed attacks decide every fight. It’s a pick-up-and-play brawler that’s deceptively simple, yet deeply rewarding once you start mastering combos and builds.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 师父训练与墨日精灵共同塑造流派
hooks.excerpt: Unlock ninja skills by training with el Mero Mero Sensei. Gain the favor of powerful Mexican-Japanese spirits and unleash their powers throughout your runs. Experiment with different builds, discover devastating combos and carve your own fighting style.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
